# CG-RES-012: Response value constraint tightened

A response constraint, pattern or format became stricter.

**Why it matters:** Narrower responses are always handled.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.constraintChanged`, `schema.patternChanged`, `schema.formatChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {what} became stricter in {where}.
>
> Consumers handle a subset of what they handled before.
>
> **Fix:** No action needed.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: maxLength tightened

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 255}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 50}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. `maxLength` became stricter in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Fires: pattern added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, pattern: '^a'}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. `pattern` became stricter in GET /x: response 200 (application/json).

### Does not fire: relaxed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 50}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, maxLength: 255}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
